items.title: Change in Congress Could Bring Wall Street a Headache
items.summary: Bank lobbyists have won watered-down capital requirements, a friendlier annual stress-testing framework, scaled-back consumer-protection enforcement, and reduced small-bank supervision while Republicans control Congress and Trump-appointed officials lead financial regulators.

items.title: Apollo Taps European Private Credit Markets With New Lending Platform
items.summary: APO launches a European lending platform to expand private credit origination, supporting its goal of nearly doubling credit AUM by 2029.

items.title: Meta Reportedly Plans To Raise $20B From Its Cross-Border Bond Sales, Including Debut Euro Offering
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is reportedly preparing to test global debt markets with a cross-border investment-grade bond offering targeting a minimum of $20 billion.

items.title: Citi expects ’continued memory undersupply’ in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi expects the global memory market to remain undersupplied next year, even after raising its supply forecasts to reflect higher bit growth guidance from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

items.title: Can Lazard's Campbell Lutyens Buyout Drive Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: LAZ's Campbell Lutyens buyout expands private capital advisory capabilities, targets $500 million in 2027 revenues and advances its long-term growth strategy.

items.title: Will Citigroup's Cost-Cut Initiatives Boost Long-Term Profitability?
items.summary: C's workforce cuts, restructuring and AI investments aim to deliver $2-$2.5 billion in annual savings and strengthen long-term profitability.

items.title: Rate Hikes Could Be Coming: History Likes These 4 Bank Stocks
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is gearing up to raise rates again, and Wall Street's four biggest banks are not equally positioned to benefit. History shows at least one of them actually loses ground when tightening cycles hit.

items.title: Alstom shares fall 6% as J.P. Morgan, Citi flag prolonged margin pressure
items.summary: Investing.com -- Alstom shares fell over 6% in Paris after J.P. Morgan and Citi downgraded the rail company and cut their price targets following a profit warning that Citi said largely relates to a €5 billion backlog on the Coradia regional train platform.
